chemistry.notes: Estimated: The Weekly Driver (spec site, no GM citation) says the 85 kWh Ultium pack is NCMA; nmc is the nearest value. Page lists the 85 kWh Ultium pack used in the Equinox EV (FWD and AWD) as NCMA (nickel cobalt manganese aluminum); recorded as nmc (the schema has no separate NCMA value). Spec-site relay of the GM pack description.

consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Test: 70 mph (113 km/h) steady, mid-80s F (~29 C), climate 70 F low fan, wheel size not stated, battery-side (car display) | 2024 Equinox EV FWD 2RS (same generation and 85 kWh pack as our 2026 FWD). Car reported 90.2 kWh used over 303 mi (3.4 mi/kWh): 90.2 kWh / 303 mi = 297.7 Wh/mi / 1.609344 = 185 Wh/km. Hot weather with A/C load. Other tests seen: Consumer Reports AWD 304 mi at 70 mph (no energy figure, paywalled).
